Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring reports on tribal community impact contributions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to tribal community impact contributions; andadding a new section to chapter 9.46 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.46 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Beginning February 1, 2007, and each February 1st thereafter, thegovernor must report to the appropriate committees of the legislatureon tribal community impact contributions made pursuant to class IIIgaming compacts entered into under RCW 9.46.360. The report mustinclude, at a minimum, the amount of funds contributed, thedistribution of those amounts, and an analysis of compliance withcompact provisions requiring such contributions, including adescription of methods used to verify compliance.
